title: The Spirit and Adoption
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The Spirit and adoption teaches that the Holy Spirit assures believers that they are children of God through Jesus Christ. By the Spirit, believers cry out to God as Father and live from their new family identity.
summary: The Spirit and adoption teaches that the Holy Spirit assures believers that they are children of God through Jesus Christ. By the Spirit, believers cry out to God as Father and live from their new family identity.
christFocus: Christ brings sinners into the family of God, and the Spirit bears witness that they belong to the Father. Adoption is secured through Christ and experienced by the Spirit’s work in the heart.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Believers do not receive a spirit of slavery leading back to fear. They receive the Spirit of adoption by whom they cry, “Abba, Father.” The Spirit teaches God’s people to approach Him as beloved children.

Adoption is rooted in Christ. God sent His Son so that sinners might receive adoption as sons. The Spirit of the Son is sent into their hearts, giving them a new relationship with God.

The Spirit bears witness with the believer’s spirit that they are children of God. This witness is not meant to produce pride, but assurance, love, reverence, and hope.

Adoption also means inheritance. Those who belong to Christ are heirs of God, even as they suffer with Christ and await glory.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people live as spiritual orphans even after believing in Christ. They relate to God mainly through fear, distance, shame, or performance. The Spirit teaches believers to know God as Father through Christ.

This doctrine is especially healing for those wounded by rejection, fatherlessness, family pain, or church hurt. Earthly relationships may fail, but God truly receives His people as His children.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Come to God as Father through Christ by the Spirit. When fear, shame, or rejection tells you that you do not belong, return to the promises of adoption. Live as a child of God: loved, corrected, kept, and called to bear the family likeness of Christ.
